content:
**Breaking news**
`@🚨 Breaking Pings `
This is UWOC news reporter 

Following from yesterdays attack, whereby the GIE was assisted by the TIC and International Comintern, the identity of the individual who conducted the attack has been, after extensive intelligence gathering, revealed.

Their username is khoisniperxz - and are part of The Armatt Pact.

It has also been revealed that they had attempted to call upon fellow faction members to come join the fight.

The Greater Israeli Empire is entirely unimpressed with what appears to be, so far, the actions of a lone-wolf - however the possibility that this was a covert mission AGAINST the empire must be explored to its fullest extent.

We have attempted to reach out to TAP's government, but have been unable to locate anybody actually associated with the faction. The possibility that this was an attack BY The Armatt Pact is absolutely unacceptable, so I urge them to reach out to clarify their intent as soon as possible
